items.question:
The guard ___ a suspicious vehicle.
Use the past tense of spot (catch sight of).
items.gloss_en: caught sight of or noticed; past form of spot
items.gloss_zh: 发现了；看见了（spot 的过去式或过去分词）
items.specific_reason: Explicit past tense of spot and sense.

items.question: The surveyors ___ the route.
items.gloss_en: represented something on a map or chart; past form of map
items.gloss_zh: 绘制了地图；映射了（map 的过去式或过去分词）
items.specific_reason: Several possible verbs, e.g. surveyed or charted.

items.question: Lightning ___ the tree.
items.gloss_en: hit something or was affected by a blow; past participle or past tense of strike
items.gloss_zh: 击中了；受到打击（strike 的过去式或过去分词）
items.specific_reason: Hit, struck, damaged all possible.

items.question: Complete: The device is ___ the document.
items.gloss_en: examining something systematically, often with a scanner; -ing form of scan
items.gloss_zh: 正在扫描；扫描（scan 的现在分词或动名词）
items.specific_reason: Reading or scanning equally possible.

items.question:
The groom ___ the horse's mane short.
Use the regular past tense of crop (cut short).
items.gloss_en: cut something short; past form of crop
items.gloss_zh: 剪短了；裁短了（crop 的过去式或过去分词）
items.specific_reason: Explicit regular past of crop and correct sense.

items.question:
They ___ to overthrow the ruler.
Use the regular past tense of plot (secretly plan).
items.gloss_en: secretly planned an action, often unlawful; past form of plot
items.gloss_zh: 密谋了；暗中策划了（plot 的过去式或过去分词）
items.specific_reason: Explicit regular past of plot and secret planning sense.

items.question: Every box was ___ clearly.
items.gloss_en: attached a label or described by a label; British spelling of labeled
items.gloss_zh: 贴上了标签（label 的英式过去式或过去分词）
items.specific_reason: Many possible verbs; UK spelling unspecified.
items.suggested_fix: Require British past participle of label.

items.question: The balloon ___ unexpectedly.
items.gloss_en: burst or made a short popping sound; past form of pop
items.gloss_zh: 砰地响了；突然弹出（pop 的过去式或过去分词）
items.specific_reason: Burst also fits.

items.question: The cat ___ onto the table.
items.gloss_en: jumped or moved suddenly; past tense of spring
items.gloss_zh: 跳起；突然出现（spring 的过去式）
items.specific_reason: Jumped or leapt also fit.

items.question: They are ___ across the mountains.
items.gloss_en: walking a long or difficult route; -ing form of trek
items.gloss_zh: 正在徒步跋涉（trek 的现在分词或动名词）
items.specific_reason: Hiking or walking also fit.

items.question: She ___ the dog gently.
items.gloss_en: stroked an animal gently; past form of pet
items.gloss_zh: 抚摸过（pet 的过去式或过去分词）
items.specific_reason: Stroked or brushed also fit.

items.question: The team is ___ the coastline.
items.gloss_en: making a map or systematically associating elements; -ing form of map
items.gloss_zh: 正在绘制地图；映射（map 的现在分词或动名词）
items.specific_reason: Surveying or charting also fit.

items.question: The expenses were ___ at the end.
items.gloss_en: added numbers together or summarized; past form of sum
items.gloss_zh: 求和了；汇总了（sum 的过去式或过去分词）
items.specific_reason: 'Expenses were summed' awkward without up; 'totaled' more natural.
items.suggested_fix: Teach summed up or specify past of sum.

items.question: Complete: This lake is ___ than the one nearby.
items.gloss_en: extending further down, inward, or into a subject than something else
items.gloss_zh: 更深的；更深入的（deep 的比较级）
items.specific_reason: Sense ID cites OEWN deeply adverb, though deeper is comparative adjective; prompt also ambiguous.
items.suggested_fix: Repair Sense identity with versioned evidence.

items.question: Her ankle was ___ after the fall.
items.gloss_en: increased in size because of fluid or inflammation; past participle of swell
items.gloss_zh: 肿胀的；膨胀的（swell 的过去分词）
items.specific_reason: Sprained or bruised fits; swollen is correct for swell form.

items.question: They ___ each other after the match.
items.gloss_en: held someone tightly in one's arms; past form of hug
items.gloss_zh: 拥抱了（hug 的过去式或过去分词）
items.specific_reason: Congratulated or greeted also fit.

items.question: The engineer is ___ the sensor in the wall.
items.gloss_en: placing something firmly within another thing; -ing form of embed
items.gloss_zh: 正在嵌入（embed 的现在分词或动名词）
items.specific_reason: Physical meaning correct but inserting or installing also fit.

items.question: He believed he had ___ against his principles.
items.gloss_en: committed a sin; past form of sin
items.gloss_zh: 犯了罪过（sin 的过去式或过去分词）
items.specific_reason: 'Sinned against principles' possible but less idiomatic than violated principles.
items.suggested_fix: Use 'sinned against God' and past participle cue.

items.question: She ___ to look under the bed.
items.gloss_en: crouched low with bent knees; past form of squat
items.gloss_zh: 蹲下了（squat 的过去式或过去分词）
items.specific_reason: Knelt or crouched also possible.

items.question: He ___ the onions finely.
items.gloss_en: cut into pieces with sharp blows; past form of chop
items.gloss_zh: 砍了；切碎了（chop 的过去式或过去分词）
items.specific_reason: Diced or minced also fit.
